articles.title: Thousands of rail passengers hit by power failure disruption
articles.description: An outage in Manchester caused delays and cancellations, with services expected to be affected throughout the evening.

articles.title: Meta fined $567m in largest child safety ruling against social media giant
articles.description: A New Mexico judge ordered the Instagram, Facebook and Whatsapp parent company to pay another $567m for the way it has harmed children.

articles.title: Arrests in Norfolk town as disorder continues for third night
articles.description: The arrests follow disorder linked to anti-immigration protests in the Norfolk market town.

articles.title: Trump again tries to limit US birthright citizenship with new executive orders
articles.description: The executive orders ban birth tourism and expand the existing definition of people whose children are not eligible for US birthright citizenship.
